intro: Chubby creates a personal retreat within your space. Its high back, cushioning, and extended seating invite you to stretch out, settle in, and enjoy comfort that lingers long after you sit down.

features.title: High-back comfort with natural support
features.text: The tall, gently contoured backrest of Chubby follows the body’s natural posture, offering support to the back and shoulders. Beneath the softness, layered foam and lumbar support work together to keep you comfortable through long conversations, relaxed reading, or unhurried afternoons.

features.title: Plush seating with a cosy embrace
features.text: Deep cushioning and generously rounded proportions create a sink-in seating experience that feels inviting without losing structure. The seat holds its shape while offering a cocoon-like comfort, making Chubby ideal for moments when you want to curl up and unwind.

features.title: Smooth, rounded armrests for relaxed lounging
features.text: The softly curved armrests are designed to support your arms naturally, encouraging laid-back postures without pressure points. Their flowing shape blends seamlessly into the sofa’s form, reinforcing a sense of continuity and gentle comfort throughout.

features.title: Soft curves with an elevated presence
features.text: Chubby balances fullness with lightness through its sculpted lines and raised legs. The generous ground clearance not only simplifies cleaning but also allows light to pass underneath, keeping the sofa visually open—even in compact rooms.

features.title: Soft-touch upholstery with tailored contrast
features.text: Wrapped in premium microfibre fabric, the seating offers a smooth, velvety feel that’s comforting to the touch and easy to maintain. Moreover, the synthetic leather accents along the sides add a structured, refined edge.

features.title: L-shaped chaise for stretch-out comfort
features.text: The elongated chaise encourages everything from solo stretching and afternoon naps to side-by-side lounging. This L-shape sofa easily shifts between me-time and movie-night mode while preserving its soft curves and plush, cocooning.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Chubby L Shaped Fab Leather Micro Fiber Rhs Sofa
